full_prompt_en: A square painterly comic-style illustration shows a teal-haired young woman in the foreground with a crowded group of people behind her in an ocher-toned interior. She stands just right of center, turned partly away but looking back toward the viewer over her shoulder. Short turquoise hair angles across her forehead; her pale face has dark-lined eyes and a firm, unsmiling mouth. She wears an orange sleeveless top with a darker brown strap or band near the waist, and one arm drops out of the lower edge. At far left, a dark-haired man leans into the frame above a smaller red-haired figure. Behind the foreground woman, a bald older man bends forward with his forearms close together, his face lined and intent. A white-haired figure looks over him from the rear. To the right, another dark-haired face appears between shoulders, while a brown-haired man in a pale rolled-sleeve shirt leans in from the upper-right middle. At the lower right, the back of another small figure or shoulder is partly visible. Their bodies overlap heavily, leaving only narrow glimpses of the room's rough vertical structures and warm glowing panels. The viewpoint is roughly level but close, compressing the group into one shallow layer. Warm amber light from above-left catches faces and shoulders, while teal and dark green shadows shape clothing and recesses. Broken brush marks, rough edges, and angular color blocks prevent the crowded image from feeling polished. The overall composition uses the forward turned head as an anchor within a restless warm ensemble, balancing orange light with cool teal accents.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形绘画式漫画插图呈现一名青绿色头发的年轻女子站在前景，身后是一群挤在赭色调室内的人。她站在中央偏右，身体部分背向观者，却从肩头回望。短短的绿松石色头发斜过额头；浅色脸上有深线勾出的眼睛和紧闭、没有笑意的嘴。她穿橙色无袖上衣，腰部附近有更深的棕色带子，一只手臂伸出下缘。最左侧深发男子从画框内倾身，下面有较小的红发人物。前景女子身后，一名秃发年长男子前俯，双前臂靠近，脸上有皱纹，神情专注。一个白发人物从后方向他上方张望。右侧另有一张深发面孔出现在肩膀之间，一名棕发男子穿浅色卷袖衬衣，从右上中部向内倾身。右下角还露出另一名较小人物的背部或肩膀。身体密集相互遮叠，房间里粗糙的竖向结构和发暖光的色块只从狭缝里显露。视点大致平齐但很近，把人群压成浅浅的一层。暖琥珀光从左上照亮脸和肩，青绿及深绿阴影塑造衣物与凹处。破碎笔痕、粗糙边缘和棱角色块让拥挤画面不显过度打磨。整体构图以前方回望的头部为锚点，在躁动的暖色群像中平衡橙光与冷青绿重音。
style_prompt_en: Painterly comic illustration layers angular figure shapes in a compressed, crowded plane. Ocher, amber, burnt orange, moss green, and turquoise are broken into irregular patches, with dark ink-like contours selectively strengthening faces and hands. Broad warm illumination catches upper planes, while cool green and blue shadow wedges separate overlapping forms. Brushwork remains visibly rough, alternating opaque blocks with scraped gaps and small sharp marks. The eye is drawn to one clear close silhouette, then travels through staggered heads into the dense backdrop. Background structures remain fragmentary so they support the group without becoming a separate scene. The overall effect is energetic, slightly gritty, and cinematic.
style_prompt_zh: 绘画式漫画插图把棱角形体层层叠在压紧而拥挤的平面里。赭黄、琥珀、焦橙、苔绿和绿松石色被打碎成不规则斑块，深色墨线状轮廓有选择地加强面部和手。宽泛暖光照亮上方平面，冷绿与蓝色阴影楔形区分相互遮叠的形体。笔触保持明显粗涩，在不透明色块、刮开空隙和细小锐利痕迹之间交替。视线先被一处清楚的近景剪影吸引，再沿错落头部进入密集背景。背景结构保持碎片化，支撑群体而不形成另一幅独立场景。整体效果充满能量、略显粗粝，并具有电影感。
theme_en: A teal-haired young woman at the front of a crowded ocher-toned ensemble
theme_zh: 青绿色短发女子站在赭色调拥挤群像的前方
name: Greg Tocchini
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
